title: tc-biometric-status
description:
Biometric enrolment across modalities – each with its status, detail and a quality meter – with the count
enrolled, an optional match score, and selectable rows.

heading.description: The heading, and the list's name

modalities.description: The modalities, a row each, in the order given

match.description: A score shown above the list, e.g. a gallery match

selected.description: The selected row's id. Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

statusLabels.description: The statuses' names, merged over the defaults (Enrolled, On file, Partial, In progress, Missing, Expired)

enrolledStatuses.description: The statuses that count as enrolled in the header

qualityLabel.description: What a row's meter measures when the row doesn't say

kind.description: Picks the icon; "other" when not given

detail.description: One line under the name, e.g. "Both eyes · captured Feb 2024"

quality.description: Quality or confidence from 0 to 1, shown as a meter and a percentage

qualityLabel.description: What `quality` measures, e.g. "Confidence"; `qualityLabel` on the element when not given

BiometricState.description: enrolled / on-file: usable · partial: some of it, or low quality · in-progress: being captured or modelled · missing: nothing yet · expired: was enrolled, needs recapture
